summary_en: 2,300,000 shares (5.72% S/O), ¥3.2B limit. Open-market purchase Aug 3, 2026–Feb 25, 2027. All acquired shares to be cancelled effective March 31, 2027. Objective: improve capital efficiency and expand shareholder returns in pursuit of long-term earnings growth.
title_en: Notice of Determination of Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: Techmatrix Corporation's board resolved on July 31, 2026 to authorize acquisition of up to 2,300,000 treasury shares (5.72% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) for a maximum of ¥3.2 billion via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange, with execution window August 3, 2026 through February 25, 2027. All shares acquired under this authorization are to be cancelled effective March 31, 2027. The stated rationale is to improve capital efficiency and expand shareholder returns while funding long-term growth investment, thereby enhancing overall enterprise value in light of current cash position.
